Copy page Copy page ​ Create Studio Templates via API Templates Added - October 2026 Turn a video into a template and mark what changes, without opening the editor New endpoints for creating Studio templates over the API. Make one video, promote it to a template, declare its variables, then generate a video per viewer with the existing POST /v3/templates/{template_id} . POST /v3/templates creates a private template from a video you generated with POST /v3/videos or saved in the HeyGen editor. GET /v3/templates/{template_id} now returns composition , every part of each scene with its id and bindable_as , plus an edit_version . The older scenes field stays for existing integrations. PUT /v3/templates/{template_id}/variables sets the full variable list. Bind avatars, voices, images, video and audio to a part by element_id , and turn exact phrases into {{name}} placeholders with match . Send expected_edit_version to get 409 stale_edit_version instead of overwriting a concurrent change. PATCH /v3/templates/{template_id} renames a template and DELETE /v3/templates/{template_id} removes it. Character variables take avatar_id . avatar_look_id and character_id are still accepted. See the new Create Studio Template via API guide. ​ HeyGen Video API Videos Added - September 2026 Generate a short video from a prompt, a first frame, or reference media The public API reference now includes POST /v3/models/videos and GET /v3/models/videos/{video_id} for the heygen-video-1 model. Choose text_to_video , image_to_video , or reference_to_video with mode . Generate 5–15 second videos at 480p or 768p with a prompt of up to 5,000 characters. Image-to-video follows the first frame’s proportions. Reference-to-video requires at least one image or video and accepts up to nine images, three videos, and three audio recordings, with twelve references total. Creation returns 202 with a video_id . Poll the status endpoint until completed , failed , or cancelled ; completed results include a download URL, and unsuccessful results include failure details. Send an Idempotency-Key header when submitting so a retry does not start a second generation. API keys need videos:write to create and videos:read to poll. ​ ElevenLabs Model Selection Voices Added - September 2026 Choose an ElevenLabs model for one speech request POST /v3/voices/speech now accepts settings.model_id with engine: "elevenlabs" . Supported models include eleven_v4 , eleven_v3 , eleven_multilingual_v2 , eleven_flash_v2 , eleven_flash_v2_5 , and eleven_turbo_v2_5 . The setting overrides the voice’s saved model preference for this request only. Omit settings to retain that preference. The deprecated elevenlabs_v3 engine retains its existing behavior while callers migrate. New integrations should select the model through settings.model_id . ​ Assets Library Folder Support Platform Videos Video Translation Changed - September 2026 Recognize Assets library folders when reading and placing results GET /v3/folders/{folder_id} documents asset alongside mixed , video , and video_translate folder types. Existing Assets library folder IDs are also accepted by routes with a folder_id destination. Assets library folders are created in the HeyGen app and are flat: POST /v3/folders cannot create them or nest another folder inside them. The HeyGen app displays only assets in Assets library folders, so a video or translation placed there may not appear in that view. ​ Professional Voice Pause Tags Voices Changed - September 2026 Use explicit pauses with a professional HeyGen voice clone The text input documentation for POST /v3/models/audio/tts and POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream now clarifies support for break time="0.5s"/ with professional voice clones. Pause values are in seconds, with a maximum of five seconds per pause; other SSML tags and break tags for instant voice clones are unsupported. ​ Scene-Scoped Edits for Video Agent Video Agent Videos Added - September 2026 Revise the scenes you name and keep the rest POST /v3/video-agents/{session_id} now accepts an edit_plan : one natural-language change per scene, applied together in a single turn. Untouched scenes keep their script and visuals, so a two-scene fix stays a two-scene fix. Read scene ids and the document’s edit_version from GET /v3/videos/{video_id}/scenes , then send each item with its scene_id , text , scene_snapshot_video_id , and edit_version . message is optional when a plan is sent. Works on sessions created in generate or chat mode. The response returns the new working draft in video_id ; poll GET /v3/videos/{video_id} for status. The whole plan is validated before submission: a scene outside the snapshot returns 400 invalid_parameter , and a snapshot that changed since it was read returns 409 stale_edit_version . Up to 50 items per request. See the new Edit Scenes guide, with a before/after example. ​ Look Packs over the API Avatars Added - September 2026 Dress an avatar you already own in a curated set of looks New endpoint: POST /v3/avatars/looks generates new looks for an existing avatar.
